verdict.rationale: The evidence describes React's actual approach as a runtime virtual-DOM diffing/reconciliation engine ('their own DOM manipulation abstraction, with efficient change management' — react-comm-10) rather than a compiler that translates components directly into surgical DOM updates at build time. No documentation or community evidence in the pack describes a compiler-based fine-grained update mechanism (e.g., React Compiler eliminating diffing); the closest material actually confirms a diffing/scheduling runtime, which is the opposite of the story's claim.
